career_ladder.note: Junior Lineman (JLM) is the frontline technical operational cadre in Southern Power Distribution Company of Telangana Limited (TSSPDCL / TGSPDCL). Governed by Andhra Pradesh / Telangana State Electricity Board (APSEB/TSEB) Service Regulations and bipartite wage settlements, progression follows a time-bound and departmental trade testing hierarchy leading up to operational engineering grades.

steps.source_label: TSSPDCL Technical Staff Service Regulations & Promotion Policy
TSSPDCL Subordinate Engineering Cadre Rules (Promotion upon acquiring Diploma/qualifying departmental exam)

exam_scheme.note: Selection process for Junior Lineman in TSSPDCL comprises an 80-mark Written Examination (Computer Based Test / OMR) of 120 minutes duration containing 80 multiple choice questions (Section A: 65 questions on ITI Electrical/Wireman syllabus; Section B: 15 questions on General Knowledge), followed by up to 20 marks in-service experience weightage for eligible contract artisans/outsourced workers, and a mandatory qualifying 8-metre Pole Climbing Test conducted for shortlisted candidates in a 1:2 ratio.

papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory qualifying test (pass/fail). Candidates who fail to climb 8-metre pole are disqualified irrespective of written score

financial_package.note: Junior Linemen are remunerated under the Telangana Power Utilities (TSSPDCL) revised bipartite pay scale of ₹24,340 – ₹39,405 per month with entry basic pay of ₹24,340, revised upwards from the previous base of ₹22,955. Allowances include Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA) ranging between 10% and 24% depending on location (GHMC/Hyderabad vs district towns), medical allowances, electricity concessions, and EPF/CPF superannuation benefits.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (10% to 24% depending on posting classification)
Dearness Allowance (indexed per power utility wage revision)
Medical reimbursement & Group Personal Accident Insurance
